hero.title: Christian Festa
hero.subTitle:
I've spent {YEARS} years as a consultant, and every engagement has been client-facing. Not the configure-someone-else's-software kind of consulting: full design, development, and integration (DDI) of custom systems. I've owned every seat in the SDLC for my clients, from requirements solicitation and UX design in Figma through hands-on development, systems and data integration, and test oversight, and I've run the whole lifecycle as a delivery manager directing teams of 30+. Most of that career has been corp-to-corp: independent contract engagements with CWDA, Unisys, and PCG spanning 2016 through 2025. Operating as an outside consultant inside a client's program is my default mode, not an adjustment.

Today that means directing a $40M AWS-hosted platform for a state agency client and building secure generative and agentic AI: Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Amazon Bedrock with layered guardrails, responsible-AI governance, and AI-accelerated engineering, with GitHub Copilot rolled out to the team under approved enterprise licensing and Claude Code with MCP in my own daily practice.

Outside client work, I build and ship my own products through my LLC, from native iOS apps with on-device AI to a direct-to-consumer brand I run with my wife, which keeps me close to what it takes to build and commercialize from zero. Available for contract and corp-to-corp engagements through Christian Festa LLC.

projects.title: Built.

roles.title: AI & Cloud Solutions Architect
roles.subTitle: I architect and deliver generative and agentic AI for enterprise clients, taking solutions from proof of concept to production. My Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems run on Amazon Bedrock with isolated foundation models and layered guardrails that protect PII and IP even under edge-case prompts, backed by a responsible-AI governance framework covering safety, privacy, and compliance. I practice AI-accelerated engineering daily with Claude Code, MCP server integrations, and agentic workflows, and I bring those patterns to the teams I lead, including rolling out GitHub Copilot under approved enterprise licensing.

roles.title: Delivery Leader & Director of Engineering
roles.subTitle: I own full-lifecycle design, development, and integration (DDI) for client programs: requirements through architecture, build, data migration, testing, and release. I'm PMP-certified, run disciplined Agile delivery, scale cross-functional onshore and offshore teams, and keep technical strategy tied to what the client's business actually needs.

roles.title: Principal UX Designer
roles.subTitle: I build design systems and UX strategy for complex, accessible, enterprise-scale interfaces. My Figma-led initiatives have doubled design-team output, enforced WCAG compliance, and produced interfaces that hold up across every device and handoff.

roles.title: Founder & Product Builder
roles.subTitle: Outside my client engagements, I build and ship products end to end through Christian Festa LLC. I design, develop, and publish native iOS apps on the App Store, including AI-powered apps that use on-device large language models, and I co-founded and operate Aloha Fitness, a direct-to-consumer brand spanning physical products and software, owning everything from international manufacturing and logistics to fulfillment, app development, and sales.

experience.title: Founder & iOS Developer
experience.lead: Shipping my own iOS products end to end through the LLC I consult from — Walkout Intros live on the App Store, Ghosty in development.

experience.title: Co-Founder

experience.title: Director of Software Engineering
experience.lead: Directing a $40M AWS-hosted platform and the firm's generative-AI practice for a California state health agency — teams of 30+ across the full lifecycle.
experience.description: As Director of Software Engineering, Technical Delivery Manager, and Principal Design Manager at a national consulting firm, I own all design, development, and integration (DDI) for a $40M AWS-hosted grant management platform delivered for a California state health agency client, spanning a public portal and an administrative back office, while building the firm's secure generative AI capability. I direct cross-functional teams of 30+ designers, developers, and engineers across the full lifecycle and serve as the client-facing technical lead. I joined corp-to-corp as an independent consultant in 2022 and converted to full-time employee in 2025 after three years of contract delivery.
bullets: Leading the build of a multi-tenant platform engineered to support a portfolio of products on shared infrastructure, currently moving toward market launch.

Led strategy and delivery of a secure Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application on Amazon Bedrock, letting users query proprietary company data through natural-language chat with zero exposure of PII or IP, even under edge-case prompts, using isolated foundation models and layered guardrails.

Drove measurable efficiency gains with the RAG application, cutting work that previously took a week or more down to a few hours by having AI handle the heavy lifting while staff review and refine the output.
Built the governance framework for responsible AI adoption, balancing fast iteration against enterprise compliance and giving the organization a repeatable model for future AI initiatives.

Architecting the platform's multi-source data migration for client handoff, spanning SharePoint document libraries, AWS MySQL and DynamoDB data stores, S3 archives, and secure SFTP/MOVEit transfer into a federal grants system, with full data-fidelity validation.

Embedded AI-accelerated engineering across the team, rolling out GitHub Copilot under the firm's approved enterprise licensing while running my own agentic practice on Claude Code and MCP server integrations, automating program management in Jira and Confluence and compressing delivery cycles across every workstream.

Stood up a Figma-based design system that standardized components, enforced WCAG compliance, and guaranteed responsive behavior across devices, streamlining design-to-development handoff and code review.
Directed onshore and offshore teams through the full project lifecycle, instituting testing workflows that took the first phase live in just three months.
Mentored designers at every level and managed client and stakeholder relationships through weekly reviews and progress reporting, keeping creative vision aligned with business goals.
Drove post-launch optimization from user feedback and performance metrics, sharpening operational efficiency and making the platform a cornerstone of the client's digital strategy.

experience.title: Technical Program and Design Manager
experience.lead: Delivery manager across three of four solutions on Hawaii's $100M BESSD modernization — design, BA, development, and test all reporting to me.
experience.description: Corp-to-corp consultant on the State of Hawaii's BESSD project, a $100M Google Cloud Platform-hosted DDI program modernizing and consolidating the state's welfare and benefits systems into a single new platform, with Medicaid kept standalone by design. I contributed to the winning RFP response for this program, and Unisys brought me back corp-to-corp to deliver it. I led the public-facing solution build, then rose to delivery manager across three of four solutions, with the design, business analysis, development, and test teams all reporting to me, directing 30+ staff across onshore and offshore teams through the full SDLC. I was taking over the administrative welfare solution as well when I concluded the engagement in 2022.
bullets: Led the DDI of everything public-facing on the program: architecture, UX, build, and delivery of the citizen-facing portal that expanded self-service and customer-service capabilities.
Promoted to delivery manager with design, BA, development, and test teams reporting to me, owning delivery end to end from requirements through deployment.
Drove early Figma adoption and built a comprehensive design system that more than doubled design-team output and accelerated the design process 2x.
Set UI/UX standards for consistency, WCAG compliance, and cross-device responsiveness, embedding them across the lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment.
Ran client stakeholder workshops and cross-team coordination, aligning deliverables to the state's consolidation goals and keeping execution built for long-term scale.
badges: Helped Win the RFP, Then Delivered It

experience.title: Technical Consultant
experience.organization: County Welfare Directors Association of California
experience.lead: State-side IV&V over the CalHEERS–county eHIT integration — validating the very interface I had built from the county side.
experience.description: Corp-to-corp Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) consultant overseeing the integration between California's CalHEERS health-benefit exchange and the county welfare eligibility systems via the eHIT interface as the program moved into long-term maintenance and operations (M&O). I had helped build that same interface from the county side on the LEADER project, which gave me a rare vantage point: validating from the state side an integration I had implemented myself.
bullets: Oversaw eHIT interface integration between CalHEERS and county systems statewide, analyzing designs and technical documentation to surface integration risks before they threatened timelines or performance.
Reviewed and signed off on technical deliverables, recommending process improvements that resolved issues early rather than after escalation.
Presented findings in biweekly reviews with developers and client stakeholders, bridging technical and non-technical teams.
Helped deliver a reliable, fully integrated system that met every contractual obligation and became a model for later initiatives.

experience.title: Technical Consultant, Development & Integration
experience.lead: New grad to lead across two flagship government DDI programs — New York's criminal-history modernization and LA County's LEADER.
experience.description: Joined straight out of Penn State and grew into a management role across two flagship government DDI engagements, wearing every hat in the SDLC: requirements, UX design, development, systems and data integration, testing, and maintenance. My whole career launched here: development, testing, integration, and the UX practice of designing the wireframes that developers built from.
bullets: NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services (DCJS), Albany, NY (2009–2011): Full modernization of New York State's criminal history repository, the system of record for every arrest in the state. The platform ingested fingerprint-event records, maintained complete criminal histories and generated rap sheets, queried federal and interstate systems including the FBI's NCIC for warrants and felony records at arrest time, and exchanged docket records with the courts to keep dispositions current. Made a lead almost immediately out of school, running the test team and building the automated regression suites.

LA County LEADER, Los Angeles, CA (2011–2016): The largest county welfare eligibility system in California, a legacy mainframe core fronted by modern Java interface services built on Spring Boot. Led the test and regression teams and became the SME on interfaces between LEADER and state systems, including implementing the eHIT exchange connecting LEADER to CalHEERS for Covered California health-benefit eligibility.

Designed and built in-house applications (largely for the LEADER project) that streamlined team workflows, cut errors, and reduced task completion time from hours to minutes. I did the UX design and wrote code hands-on.
Set standards and protocols for multi-system case data exchange, enabling seamless data sharing across agencies, and led implementation builds through to deployment.
Designed wireframes and interaction flows that developers built from, translating complex public-sector requirements into clear, usable interfaces.
Contributed to winning RFP responses that secured $100M+ in contracts, including the Hawaii BESSD bid that Unisys later brought me back corp-to-corp to deliver.
Managed teams of up to 25 through full system builds, third-party integrations, and user-acceptance testing.
